titles.blockCreate: Block is on Cabin — refresh OTAs

steps.exportLive: Cabin updated the calendar we send out (export is live).
steps.confirmWithChannel: {{channel}} already has this guest — refresh the other channels below.
steps.walkIn: OTAs do not know about this stay yet until they pull our calendar.
steps.stayUpdate: OTAs still show the old dates/unit until they pull our calendar.
steps.blockClosure: OTAs do not know about this closure yet until they pull our calendar.

refreshImports.footer: Auto sync can take hours. Refresh when check-in is soon.

cancel.title: Cancel on {{channel}} too
steps: Cabin cancelled this stay and freed the unit on our calendar.
{{channel}} does not cancel the guest booking by itself — open {{channel}} and cancel (or modify) that reservation.
If you leave it active on {{channel}}, the next sync may warn that it is still listed.

checkOut.title: Update {{channel}} if needed
steps: Cabin checked the guest out and updated the busy calendar we send out.
If they left early, or the booking on {{channel}} should end, edit or cancel that reservation on {{channel}}.
{{channel}} will not change the guest booking automatically.

datesOrUnit.title: Update {{channel}} too
steps: Cabin already saved the new dates/unit and updated the busy calendar we send out.
{{channel}} does not update the guest’s booking by itself — you must edit that reservation on {{channel}}.
Make dates and unit match Cabin, or the next sync will warn that the two sides disagree.

missingFromFeed.what: {{channel}} no longer shows this booking in its calendar.
pickOne: Guest cancelled on {{channel}} → cancel this stay in Cabin too.
Feed looks wrong / temporary → dismiss for now and check again after the next sync.
missingFromFeed.verify: Look up this guest on {{channel}}. Is the booking still there?
missingFromFeed.cabin: If it’s gone for real, cancel this stay. That frees the unit and closes money if needed.
missingFromFeed.dismissHint: Only hides the alert until the next sync. It will come back if the booking is still missing.

pickOne: {{channel}} is correct → use their dates in Cabin (revisit Total after).
Cabin is correct → change the booking dates on {{channel}} to match.
datesDiffer.verify: Open the guest reservation on {{channel}} and compare the stay dates.
datesDiffer.cabin: To match {{channel}}, tap Use {{channel}} dates. Or edit this stay in Cabin, then update {{channel}}.
datesDiffer.otaStep: If Cabin should win, edit the reservation on {{channel}} so dates match {{stayDates}}.
datesDiffer.dismissHint: Keeps Cabin’s dates. The alert returns on the next sync until both sides match.

unitDiffer.whatWithDates: {{channel}} has this on unit {{observed}} ({{otaCheckIn}} → {{otaCheckOut}}). Cabin has unit {{unitCode}} ({{stayDates}}).
unitDiffer.whatUnitOnly: {{channel}} has this on unit {{observed}}. Cabin still has unit {{unitCode}}.
pickOne: {{channel}} is correct → move this stay to unit {{observed}} in Cabin.
Cabin is correct → move the booking back to unit {{unitCode}} on {{channel}}.
unitDiffer.verify: On {{channel}}, which unit did the guest actually book?
unitDiffer.cabin: To match {{channel}}, tap Move to {{channel}}’s unit (fails if that unit is already busy).
unitDiffer.otaStep: If Cabin should win, change the listing/unit on {{channel}} back to {{unitCode}}.
unitDiffer.dismissHint: Leaves the stay on this unit. The alert returns on the next sync until both sides match.

importOverlap.what: These nights ({{stayDates}}) on unit {{unitCode}} are already taken by another stay or block. This {{channel}} booking is waiting — it does not block the calendar yet.
pickOne: Keep the other stay → cancel this {{channel}} booking in Cabin (and on {{channel}} if it isn’t a real guest).
Keep this {{channel}} guest → free {{stayDates}} on the other stay first (cancel or move it), then tap below.
importOverlap.verify: Check the calendar for unit {{unitCode}} and the booking on {{channel}}. Who should keep these nights?
importOverlap.cabin: After the other stay is gone or moved, tap Nights are free now. Then fill guest details and Confirm. Or cancel this booking if the other stay wins.
importOverlap.otaStep: If you cancel here because {{channel}} double-sold, fix or cancel the booking on {{channel}} too.
importOverlap.dismissHint: “Nights are free now” only works after the conflict is gone. If nights are still busy, cancel this booking or free the other stay first.

otaStillListed.what: Cabin already marked this stay as {{statusLabel}}, but {{channel}} still shows it as booked.
pickOne: Intentional (early checkout, local cancel) → cancel or update the booking on {{channel}}, then dismiss.
otaStillListed.verify: Open {{channel}} and check whether this booking is still active.
otaStillListed.cabin: Cabin is already closed for this stay. Nothing to change here except dismiss after you verify.
otaStillListed.otaStep: If {{channel}} should not list this guest anymore, cancel or change that booking there.
otaStillListed.dismissHint: Won’t warn again while this booking stays on the feed. If it disappears and comes back later, the alert can return.

acceptDates.title: Use {{channel}} dates?
acceptDates.description: Cabin will change this stay from {{checkIn}} → {{checkOut}} to {{otaDates}}. Revisit Total if the length of stay changed.

acceptUnit.title: Move to {{observed}}?
acceptUnit.description: This stay will move from unit {{unitCode}} to {{observed}}. It fails if {{observed}} already has overlapping nights.

clearHold.title: Mark nights free?
clearHold.description: Only continue if {{checkIn}} → {{checkOut}} on unit {{unitCode}} are actually free. This clears the double-book alert so you can Confirm the {{channel}} booking.

dismiss.descriptionChecked: Hides this alert. It will not come back on the next sync unless {{channel}} drops the booking and lists it again later.
dismiss.descriptionForNow: Hides this alert until the next sync. If nothing changed on {{channel}}, it will likely come back.
